description: Pure enrichment module for the domain_trust signal. Although domain_trust currently shows OK range (44.8-85.0), enrichment will improve discrimination beyond base signal. Build compute_score(metadata: dict) that reads MULTIPLE fields: registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars. Must return (float in [0,100], evidence_dict) per section 3 signal invariant. Must complete in under 2 seconds. Must NOT write to DB, import protected modules, or make network calls. Pure function: same input always produces same output. Export exactly: def compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict]. Will be evaluated by enrichment_harness.py against synthetic corpus; requires >=20 distinct scores for acceptance.
